info.name: Elf (Azeroth)
info.description: The Elf (Azeroth) species from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: In ancient ages, night elves founded a vast empire that spanned the world. But as Queen Azshara and the elite Highborne nobles of her court delved into the secrets of arcane magic, using spells to manipulate the cosmic energy of the Well of Eternity, the elves drew the attention of the titan Sargeras, creator of the demonic Burning Legion. Sargeras convinced Azshara and her loyal high councilor, Xavius, to open a portal that would allow the Legion to enter the world. The resulting conflict, the War of the Ancients, brought all the young peoples of the world together—night elves, tauren, furbolgs, earthen, dragons, and Wild Gods—to repel the Burning Legion. But the price of closing the portal was the Great Sundering, which shattered the continent into the landmasses of the world today. The Great Sea covered the heart of the ancient continent, and the site of the Well of Eternity is now the swirling Maelstrom.

Just as the continent was shattered in the Great Sundering, the elves were scattered and divided by the cataclysmic event. The Highborne who sided with Azshara were transformed into naga and satyrs (see chapter 7), while those who resisted her continued to pursue arcane magic. The rest of the night elves remained isolated for ten thousand years.

Night Elves (Kaldorei). Forswearing the use of arcane magic, the night elves (or kaldorei, which means “children of the stars” in their own language, Darnassian) cultivated a druidic society in the shadowed recesses of Ashenvale Forest. Night elves average between 7 and 8 feet in height, with skin from pale lilac to dark violet and eyes that glow white, blue, or gold.

Nightborne (Shal’dorei). Isolated for ten thousand years in Suramar and transformed by the energy of the Nightwell, the nightborne joined the ranks of the Horde after a rebellion toppled their corrupt leaders. They resemble night elves, though their skin is darker and grayer.

High Elves (Quel’dorei). Descendants of the Highborne who founded Quel’Thalas around the Sunwell, the high elves who refused to adopt the blood elves’ parasitic techniques now live among the peoples of the Alliance with no nation of their own. Their eyes glow blue.
Blood Elves (Sin’dorei). Most survivors of Quel’Thalas took on the name “blood elves” to honor their fallen kindred and joined the Horde. They resemble high elves, but their eyes glow green or gold.

Void Elves (Ren’dorei). Exiled from Silvermoon for studying the Void and trained by Alleria Windrunner to control the shadows within themselves, the void elves pledged their support to the Alliance. Their eyes glow violet, and their hair is varying shades of purple and blue.
Your starting Renown Score depends on your elven origin:
Blood Elf or Nightborne. Your Renown Score with Silvermoon City (Horde) begins at 3.
High Elf. You have no starting Renown Score.
Night Elf or Void Elf. Your Renown Score with Darnassus (Alliance) begins at 3.

You have the Elf species traits from the Player’s Handbook: Darkvision (60 feet), Fey Ancestry, Keen Senses, and Trance. Instead of the Player’s Handbook Elven Lineage options, choose one of the lineages below or the High Elf option. The general rules for Elven Lineage apply in any case.

Elven Lineage. You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the Elven Lineage options from the Azeroth Elven Lineages table or the High Elf option from the Player’s Handbook. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).
